units.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python reads .one files and writes .pdf files. It converts documents containing pages, rich text, images, tables, attached files, note tags, and numbered lists from the .one format to .pdf. The product supports reading from file paths or binary streams and saving with configurable options such as JPEG quality for PDF output.

It reads .one files from a file path or binary stream into a document object model using the aspose.note.Document class, supporting both direct file paths and file-like objects without requiring Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

It traverses the document tree using CompositeNode.GetChildNodes for type-based node search and the DocumentVisitor pattern for full hierarchical traversal, supporting Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes.

It extracts rich text content with per-run formatting through TextRun and TextStyle, supporting bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font, color, and hyperlink properties, as well as paragraph-level styling via RichText.ParagraphStyle.
It exports pages to .pdf files using SaveFormat.Pdf and PdfSaveOptions, allowing control over JPEG image quality and other export settings through the aspose.note.saving module.
It extracts embedded images and attached files by accessing their Bytes property and associated metadata such as FileName, enabling direct saving to disk using standard file I/O operations.

It inspects tables through Table, rows, and cells; OneNote tags attached to text, images, and tables via NoteTag with labels and statuses; and numbered lists through NumberList properties including format, number format, and restart behavior.
It accesses page metadata including Title, Author, CreationTime, and Level, plus retrieves page revision history through PageHistory and Document.GetPageHistory for version inspection.

It raises FileCorruptedException for malformed files, IncorrectDocumentStructureException for structural inconsistencies, and UnsupportedFileFormatException for unrecognized formats during document loading.
The example loads a OneNote file and exports it to PDF using the Save method with SaveFormat.Pdf.
The example opens a OneNote file in binary mode, constructs a Document from the file handle, and prints its DisplayName and page count.

The following examples demonstrate common tasks: saving embedded images, loading from a binary stream, traversing tables, extracting attached files, inspecting tags, counting nodes, extracting text, exporting to PDF, extracting hyperlinks, and inspecting numbered lists.
Save embedded images to disk.
Traverse tables and extract cell text.
Extract attached files from a document.
Inspect OneNote tags and their status.
Count document nodes using a visitor.
Extract all text from rich text nodes.
Export to PDF with custom JPEG quality.
Extract hyperlinks and their addresses.
Inspect numbered list formatting properties.

The primary entry point is aspose.note.Document, which loads a .one file and exposes its pages as a tree of nodes; Document.Save() writes the document to PDF. The supported public entry points are aspose.note and aspose.note.saving.
The aspose.note.Document class loads a .one file and exposes its pages as a tree of nodes; it provides GetPageHistory(), DetectLayoutChanges(), and Save() to write the document to PDF.

The aspose.note.Page class represents a page in a document and provides Clone(), while aspose.note.Title holds the page title text, date, and time, and aspose.note.PageHistory manages page revisions with methods such as Add(), Remove(), and Count.

The aspose.note.RichText class holds formatted text with TextRuns, supports text manipulation via Append(), Insert(), Remove(), and Replace(), and exposes Tags and Alignment; aspose.note.TextRun and aspose.note.TextStyle provide per-run formatting details.
The aspose.note.Image class exposes image data via Bytes and FileName, and supports AlternativeTextTitle, AlternativeTextDescription, and HyperlinkUrl.
The aspose.note.AttachedFile class exposes attached file data via Bytes and FileName, and supports Tags.
The aspose.note.Table class represents a table with Columns, IsBordersVisible, and Tags; aspose.note.TableRow and aspose.note.TableCell provide the row and cell structure.

The aspose.note.NoteTag class represents a tag with Label, Icon, Status, Highlight, CreationTime, CompletedTime, and FontColor, and provides factory methods such as CreateYellowStar() and CreateQuestionMark().
The aspose.note.NumberList class provides list formatting via Format, NumberFormat, Font, FontSize, FontColor, IsBold, IsItalic, and Restart, and supports GetNumberedListHeader().
The aspose.note.DocumentVisitor class provides a visitor pattern base with methods such as VisitPageStart(), VisitRichTextStart(), and VisitImageStart() to traverse document nodes.
The aspose.note.SaveFormat class specifies output formats, currently limited to Pdf.
The aspose.note.saving module provides PdfSaveOptions for configuring PDF export, including JpegQuality and other settings.
The aspose.note.exceptions module defines FileCorruptedException, IncorrectDocumentStructureException, and UnsupportedFileFormatException for error handling.
The getting started guide covers installation, walkthroughs, and feature guides for this library.
The how-to guides and FAQ provide task-focused answers for common OneNote-parsing questions.
The full API reference offers a complete, browsable reference for all 39 public types.
Users can open issues on GitHub to report bugs or request features.
Aspose.Note FOSS for Python reads OneNote files and exports them to PDF; it does not write back to .one files, support encrypted documents, or export to formats other than PDF.
Writing back to .one files is not implemented, and SaveFormat currently declares only Pdf, so Document.Save() raises UnsupportedSaveFormatException for any other format or options object.
LoadOptions.DocumentPassword and encrypted documents are not supported — supplying a password raises IncorrectPasswordException.
License.SetLicense() and Metered.SetMeteredKey() are present for API-shape compatibility with the commercial product but are no-ops in this edition — no license is required to use this library.
DetectLayoutChanges() is a compatibility stub and performs no layout computation.

All exceptions inherit from AsposeNoteError, including FileCorruptedException for a malformed OneStore container, IncorrectDocumentStructureException for an unexpected object graph, and UnsupportedFileFormatException when the source isn't a recognized OneNote format.

Aspose.Note FOSS for Python requires Python 3.10 or later and is tested on Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12. The test suite resides in the tests/ directory and includes smoke tests, DOM content and document tests, exception handling, rich text formatting, save options, and tag support. PDF golden-output tests compare generated PDFs against manifests in tests/goldens/pdf/ rather than raw bytes to remain stable across platforms and ReportLab internals, using deterministic Base-14 fonts by default. When a PDF test fails, the generated PDFs and manifests are written to tests/out/pdf_golden_failures/ for inspection, and if PyMuPDF is installed, visual diff artifacts are also produced; if PyMuPDF is unavailable but pdftoppm is on PATH, the tests fall back to pdftoppm. Regenerate PDF baselines after intentional changes using tools/regenerate_pdf_goldens.py, optionally specifying individual cases.
It adds full read/write support (including writing OneNote files back out), broader format conversion, and wider OneNote compatibility beyond what this free edition covers.
The aspose.note.AttachedFile class represents an attached file node in a document, inheriting from Node and providing access to its bytes and file name.
The aspose.note.Document class represents a document node that inherits from CompositeNode and provides methods to load, save, and access its pages and layout changes.
The aspose.note.DocumentVisitor class provides a visitor pattern implementation to traverse and process document nodes including the document itself, pages, outlines, and text elements.
The aspose.note.FileCorruptedException class represents an error raised when a document file is corrupted and cannot be loaded.
The aspose.note.FileFormat class represents an enumeration of supported file formats for loading and saving documents.
The aspose.note.HorizontalAlignment class represents an enumeration of horizontal alignment options for content.
The aspose.note.Image class represents an image node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and providing access to its bytes, format, and dimensions.
The aspose.note.IncorrectDocumentStructureException class represents an error raised when a document has an incorrect or unsupported structure.
The aspose.note.IncorrectPasswordException class represents an error raised when an incorrect password is provided for a protected document.
The aspose.note.License class provides functionality to set a license for the Aspose.Note library.
The aspose.note.LoadOptions class provides options for loading a document.
The aspose.note.Metered class provides functionality to set metered key credentials for the Aspose.Note library.
The aspose.note.Node class represents a base node in the document object model.
The aspose.note.NodeType class represents an enumeration of node types in the document object model.
The aspose.note.NoteTag class represents a note tag that can be applied to text or other elements in a document.
The aspose.note.NumberList class represents a numbered list that can be applied to text elements in a document.
The aspose.note.Outline class represents an outline node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing outline elements.
The aspose.note.OutlineElement class represents an outline element node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing text or other content.
The aspose.note.Page class represents a page node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing title, outline, and other content.
The aspose.note.PageHistory class represents a history of versions for a page in a document.
The aspose.note.ParagraphStyle class represents a style that can be applied to paragraphs in a document.
The aspose.note.RichText class represents rich text content in a document, inheriting from Node and containing text runs with formatting.
The aspose.note.SaveFormat class represents an enumeration of supported save formats for exporting documents.
The aspose.note.Table class represents a table node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing rows.
The aspose.note.TableCell class represents a table cell node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing content.
The aspose.note.TableColumn class represents a table column definition in a document.
The aspose.note.TableRow class represents a table row node in a document, inheriting from CompositeNode and containing cells.
The aspose.note.TagStatus class represents an enumeration of status values for note tags.
The aspose.note.TextRun class represents a run of text with consistent formatting in a document.
The aspose.note.TextStyle class represents a style that can be applied to text in a document.
The aspose.note.Title class represents a title node in a document, inheriting from Node and containing title text.
The aspose.note.UnsupportedFileFormatException class represents an error raised when a file format is not supported.
The aspose.note.UnsupportedSaveFormatException class represents an error raised when a save format is not supported.
The aspose.note.exceptions.AsposeNoteError class represents the base exception class for errors in the Aspose.Note library.
The aspose.note.model.CompositeNode class represents a composite node that can contain child nodes in the document object model.
The aspose.note.model.PdfSaveOptions class provides options for saving a document to PDF format.
The aspose.note.model.SaveOptions class provides base options for saving a document.
